- All required gates now pass on the final state: make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long.
- Updated source docs to reflect the reduced HA feature inventory, marked the Ralph task file as completed with passes=true, and ran task_switch.sh.
- Next I am preparing the final commit, taking care to stage task-related changes without sweeping in unrelated pre-existing source edits.

- Read the Ralph progress log and both current task summary files.
- Saw active failing tasks in `story-general-architecture-improvement-finding` and `story-ha-acceptance-deletion-first-rewrite`, all shown so far as `high` priority.
- Need to inspect the full active task list and individual task files for blockers/story ordering, then write the selected task path into `.ralph/current_task.txt` and stop.

- Resolved active candidates from `.ralph/current_tasks.md`: one standalone high-priority general-architecture task (`08`) and five high-priority HA rewrite tasks (`02`-`06`).
- Confirmed there are no active failing bug tasks in the current task summary, and the relevant predecessor tasks in both active stories are already marked passing/done (`story-ha .../01`, `story-general-architecture .../06` and `07`).
- Chose `.ralph/tasks/story-ha-acceptance-deletion-first-rewrite/02-task-delete-scenario-bookkeeping-and-shrink-the-ha-world-and-step-surface.md` because it is the first unblocked deletion-first foundation in the active HA rewrite story; later tasks in that story depend on simplifying the world/step surface before rebuilding observation/invariants.

- Read the active Ralph task and confirmed it is in NOW EXECUTE mode.
- Verified the current HA feature files already use a reduced DSL; the task is real because support/world/steps still carry the old proof/workload/history scaffolding.
- Next I am rewriting tests/ha/support/world/mod.rs into a minimal alias + availability state model, then I will replace tests/ha/support/steps/mod.rs with only the feature-backed steps and delete tests/ha/support/workload/mod.rs.

- Completed the deletion-first HA harness rewrite: removed tests/ha/support/workload/mod.rs, shrank HaWorld to aliases plus availability, and replaced the step layer with only the reduced feature-backed DSL.
- Verified the task state with make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long; all passed after trimming dead helper APIs that became orphaned.
- Updated docs/src/how-to/run-tests.md to remove stale proof-write guidance, then marked the Ralph task file passing and am about to run task_switch.sh before preparing the task-finish commit.
